lines: Death to the Strawheads!
All will flee from the might of Dunland!
Few can stand before the might of a mob of Dunlendings!
We Men of Dunland are proud and loyal warriors.
We Men of Dunland are strong and great warriors! We shall cleanse the lands of the filthy dogs of Rohan!
Get some more deeds to your name, #p, and I might let you command my warriors!
I almost mistook you for one of those filthy Strawheads.
You'll have to earn some respect among our people if you want to lead us into battle.
And what do you want?
You are yet young among our people, #p. Great Men do not follow lesser Men.
You want to hire some Dunlendings? Prove your worth first, #p!
We would not let a simple and strange Man, such as yourself, command our mighty troops!
The great warriors of Dunland will not follow a stranger into battle.
We do not simply follow any mere Man to war.
You want to command my troops? You need to prove yourself to our people first!
Only great heroes of our people are worthy of leading us into battle!
The service of my warriors can be yours for just a few silver coins.
My Men will follow you into battle without fear.
You wish to bring death to the Strawheads? My Men shall fight for you!
Those filthy Rohirrim shall feel the edge of our swords!
Give me just a few silver coins, and I will give you my mighty warriors.
I have many strong warriors ready for hire, #!
Looking to hire an army, #p?
Have any silver coins, #p?
A drunkard like you could never lead my men.
How will you lead men if you're as drunk as a donkey?
Lay off on that ale first, and then you can lead my warriors.
Who do you take us for? We dunlendings don't follow drunkards.
